title: zazzle-csharp-indexer source component diagram
description: The parts of the zazzle-csharp-indexer executable. The same binary is the stdio server, the shared daemon and the init, hook and report commands; one engine per process holds the store and the indexes.

components.name: zazzle-csharp-indexer executable
components.responsibility: Everything zazzle-csharp-indexer does, in one process per command.

components.name: Command line (Program.cs)
components.responsibility: Dispatches serve, daemon, init, report, hook and --version; wires roots, the engine, the daemon proxy and the MCP server together.

components.name: Engine, store and roots (Engine.cs, Store.cs, Root.cs)
components.responsibility: The SQLite store, in-memory blob and symbol-name tables, one live index per root path, root validation and path resolution.

components.name: Usage log (UsageLog.cs)
components.responsibility: Appends one JSON line per tool call or hook decision to usage.jsonl in the state directory.

components.name: Process and path helpers (Proc.cs, Native.cs)
components.responsibility: Runs external programs with an argument list, a timeout and an 8 MiB output cap; resolves symlinks with realpath.

components.name: Content analysis
components.responsibility: Blob ids, Bloom filters, symbols and identifiers from file bytes.

components.name: Live index
components.responsibility: Keeps each root's file records current.

components.name: Shared daemon
components.responsibility: The per-user daemon and the proxy serve runs in front of it.

components.name: MCP server
components.responsibility: JSON-RPC dispatch to the tools, with a usage-log record per call.

components.name: MCP tools
components.responsibility: The thirteen tools agents and zazzled call.

components.name: Command-line helpers
components.responsibility: init, which also registers zazzle's MCP server when zazzled is installed; the redirect hook's policy, which sends raw reads and searches to zazzle; and report.

components.name: Terse C# view
components.responsibility: Builds a shortened, line-numbered view of a C# file from its syntax tree.

components.name: Coding agent's client (for example Claude Code)
components.responsibility: Starts zazzle-csharp-indexer serve as an MCP server and, after init, runs zazzle-csharp-indexer hook before Bash, Grep, Glob and Read calls.

components.name: git command-line tool
components.responsibility: Work-tree checks, file listings, ignore checks, log, blame and grep.

relationships.description: Starts zazzle-csharp-indexer serve and speaks MCP on its standard input and output; runs zazzle-csharp-indexer hook with a JSON event.
